objective: Đặt một simple data question, xác định observational units và variable/categories, collect/record observations bằng rule nhất quán, rồi classify/count chúng vào tally/frequency table có total kiểm tra được.
misconceptions_or_representation_notes: Data are observations recorded under a rule; they do not appear already tabulated.
Categories must cover counted observations without unintended overlap.
Recording/coding choices affect what can later be concluded.
change_reason: Added direct C023 support for the previously removed collect/record action, restoring full G07 foundational meaning without importing B1.5 acquisition systems.
